title: What the Dog Became
description: It was a dog, once. You can tell by the shape of the skull, the way it holds its forelegs - but the proportions have shifted, the jaw unhinged too wide, the eyes set too far back in the sockets. It does not growl. It watches you with a stillness that no dog ever had.

standard_attack.telegraph: It drops its shoulders and surges forward, jaw splitting wider than it should.

special_attacks.telegraph: It has been watching you retreat behind your guard. Something shifts in its posture - the jaw unhinges further with a sound like wet rope snapping, and it coils impossibly low against the floorboards.
It stops moving entirely. The silence thickens like fog. Then it is simply closer than it was - no visible transition, no sound - and its empty eyes are fixed on something behind your face.

pre_combat_narrative: The stillness breaks all at once.

visual.alt_text: A dog-shaped thing in a dim entryway, jaw unhinged too wide, eyes set wrong, body coiled to lunge.
